title: How many streams is a Gold record?
description: A Gold single takes 75 million on-demand US streams, a Gold album 750 million. The full RIAA stream-to-unit math, with what does and doesn't count.
faq: How many streams do you need for a Gold record?

A Gold single needs 500,000 units, which is 75 million on-demand US streams if streams are all you have (150 streams = 1 unit). A Gold album needs 750 million (1,500 streams = 1 album unit). Paid downloads count too.
How many streams is Platinum?
Platinum is 1,000,000 units: 150 million on-demand US streams for a single, or 1.5 billion for an album.
Do international streams count toward RIAA certification?
No. RIAA certification only counts sales and on-demand streams in the United States.

title: Can independent artists get RIAA certified?
description: Yes. The RIAA program is open to non-members and accepts distributor and artist royalty statements. What it costs, what you need, and who applies.
faq: Can an independent artist get a Gold record?
Yes. The RIAA Gold & Platinum Program is open to members and non-members, and it accepts sales data from distributors or detailed artist royalty statements.
How much does RIAA certification cost?
Non-members pay $450 per certification level, paid up front. RIAA members pay $350 per title. The fee is non-refundable.
Is RIAA certification automatic?
No. Someone has to submit a request with sales and streaming data and pay for the audit.

title: What counts toward RIAA Gold and Platinum?
description: On-demand US streams and paid downloads count. TikTok, international plays, radio, Content ID and free downloads don't. The full list, plus which versions you can combine.
faq: Do TikTok plays count toward a Gold record?
No. User-generated content on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and similar platforms doesn't count toward RIAA certification.
Do YouTube views count toward RIAA certification?
On-demand streams of official videos count, including videos on the artist's or label's channel. User-generated uploads and Content ID claims on other people's videos don't.
Do Pandora and SiriusXM plays count?
Only on-demand streams count. Radio-style plays where the listener didn't pick the song, like SiriusXM or non-interactive Pandora stations, don't.
Can clean and explicit versions be combined?
Yes. For a single, clean and explicit versions, radio edits and remixes no more than 90 seconds longer than the original can be combined. Live versions are certified separately.

title: RIAA album units, explained
description: One album unit = 1 album download, 10 track downloads, or 1,500 US streams. How every track, including early singles, counts toward Gold.
faq: How many streams equal one album unit?
1,500 on-demand US streams of the album's tracks equal one album unit. So do 10 track downloads or 1 album download.
Do singles released before the album count toward the album?
Yes, as long as the single appears on some version of the album.
Can a song count toward both a single and album certification?
Yes. The single and album programs are separate, so a track can count toward both.

title: How to apply for RIAA certification
description: Step by step: confirm you've crossed the line, pull a US sales summary by store, prepare label copy, submit to the RIAA and work with the GR&F audit.
faq: Where do you apply for RIAA certification?
Requests go through the RIAA's Quick Request Portal at certification.riaa.com.
Who audits RIAA certifications?
Gelfand, Rennert & Feldman (GR&F) audits requests on the RIAA's behalf.
How long do you have to submit documents?
All audit requirements must be provided within 30 days of the application date, or the request may be denied.

title: How to get an official RIAA plaque
description: After certification, any contributor can order an official RIAA award from a licensed framer. Who can order, where, and how to spot a real one.
faq: Does the RIAA send you a plaque?
No. Once a title is certified, artists, labels and contributors order official plaques from RIAA-licensed framers.
Who can buy an RIAA plaque?
Any artist, label or affiliated party who contributed to a certified title.
How can you tell an RIAA plaque is official?
Official RIAA awards carry an RIAA hologram and are made by RIAA-licensed framers.
